description: The rest of c's written [T [X] [U]] is an empty ordinary optional and then a restoration. Because [U] can read, [X] is predicted in the ordinary way and may be empty, and [U] restores U. So c is a second reading (engine §7.4). Here c's inner [U] is predicted only strictly. A strict and an ordinary prediction of one helper at one position share their items, so a fault in the strict path shows only where that path is the only one, or comes first.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [+T] [+U] [+V]
%rule b A [+T] [+U] [+V] [+W]
%rule c A [+T [X] [+U]] V
